positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed a testing tool using Java and Spring Boot which takes JSON objects from Splunk, sends them to an API, extracts the response messages from the, and outputs them to a CSV file.
